thread:
Marta: morning folks — quick deploy coordination. We have a small feature push to inference-routing (canary) today. Targeting 15:00 UTC slot. Who's taking lead? Also need smoke runner and DB watch. Tags: @Cheng @Devon

Cheng: I can lead the deploy at 15:00 UTC. I'll do canary for 10% traffic. Set me as owner.

Devon: I'll own smoke. Quick checklist: run smoke job, validate /health, sample gen + latency < 120ms, check `redis-ks` hit rate. I'll post results.

Priya: FYI there's a lightweight migration — adds index to routes table (non-blocking). Will run migration in preflight at 14:45 and rollback plan ready. Migration will be zero-downtime but need watch on replica lag.

Marta: plan — 14:30 prep, 14:45 migration preflight (Priya), 14:55 snapshot, 15:00 canary rollout (Cheng), 15:10 smoke (Devon), 15:20 evaluate and either promote or rollback. If promote -> gradual rollout 10->50->100 over 20m. If rollback -> immediate abort and route back. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/deploys#inference-routing

Cheng: ack. Will create canary with `kubectl set image` and `kubectl rollout status` then adjust traffic with router-service. I'll tag with `canary/20260318-1716789012`.

Devon: smoke commands I'll run:

```bash
# smoke
curl -sS https://staging.api.redwood.ai/health
python tools/smoke_tests/run_sample_gen.py --model="rwd-small" --count=5
kubectl logs -l app=inference-routing --tail=100 | grep "error"
```

I'll paste pass/fail and short metrics.

Priya: rollback plan: `ALTER INDEX CONCURRENTLY` not reversible; fallback is route to previous model variant + rollback deploy. I'll have DB snapshot and run `pg_rewind` if needed.

deploy-bot: Booked 15:00 UTC slot for `inference-routing` canary; reminder 10m prior.

Marta: cool. Cheng ping me when canary created. Devon, mark smoke pass as ✅ or ❌. Priya, call DB done when preflight complete.

Cheng: canary created at 15:00. image tagged. routing at 10%.

Devon: smoke run: health OK, sample gen 5/5 correct, p50=85ms p95=180ms (slightly high). Redis hit rate 92%. Marking as: ⚠️ borderline latency.

Marta: decision — hold promotion, increase canary to 25% for 10m to gather more p95. If p95 stays >200 rollback. Cheng please increase.

Cheng: increasing to 25% now.

Devon: new p95 after 5m=165ms. I'll continue to watch.

Marta: after additional 10m p95=160 -> promote to 50%. Cheng execute.

Cheng: promoted to 50%, then 100. All good.

Priya: migration preflight completed at 14:45, no replication lag. DB snapshot taken 14:55.

Marta: thanks all. I'll update runbook and close slot. :tada:
